def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in {x for row in grid for x in row}}
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    separator_col = next(c for c in range(w)
                         if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
                         and grid[0][c] != background)
    separator = grid[0][separator_col]
    object_color = next(v for v in counts if v not in (background, separator))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == object_color]
    left, right = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)

    # Shift the object so its nearest edge is one cell from the divider.
    if right < separator_col:
        shift = separator_col - 1 - right
        stripe = left + shift - 1
    else:
        shift = separator_col + 1 - left
        stripe = right + shift + 1

    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = background
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c + shift] = object_color
    if 0 <= stripe < w:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][stripe] = 8
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in {x for row in grid for x in row}}
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    # The full-width/height non-background line is the divider.
    if any(len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg for row in grid):
        r = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg)
        obj = next(v for v in counts if v not in (bg, grid[r][0]))
        rows = [i for i in range(h) if obj in grid[i]]
        stripe = max(rows) + 1
        if stripe < h:
            out[stripe] = [8] * w
    else:
        c = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != bg)

        cols = [j for j in range(w) if any(grid[i][j] == obj for i in range(h))]
        stripe = max(cols) + 1
        if stripe < w:
            for i in range(h):
                out[i][stripe] = 8
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    bg = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Identify full straight divider, then the remaining non-background object.
    hr = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg), None)
    if hr is not None:
        div = grid[hr][0]
        obj = next(v for v in colors if v not in (bg, div))
        occupied = [r for r in range(h) if any(x == obj for x in grid[r])]
        stripe = max(occupied) + 1
        if stripe < h:
            out[stripe] = [8] * w
    else:
        dc = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg)
        div = grid[0][dc]
        obj = next(v for v in colors if v not in (bg, div))
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == obj]
        left, right = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        # Slide the object toward the divider, preserving its shape.
        shift = dc + 1 - left if left > dc else dc - 1 - right
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c + shift] = obj
        stripe = (right + shift + 1) if left > dc else (left + shift - 1)
        if 0 <= stripe < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][stripe] = 8
    return out
